newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov overseas ship orders drop 73.4 yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov overseas ship orders drop 73.4 yr/yr.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipbuilders in November totalled 14 vessels, or 207,004 gross registered tons (grt), down 73.4 percent from the same period a year earlier, an industry body said on Thursday.

"The fall in November was exaggerated as contracts in November last year were particularly good as the yen was weaker against the dollar around that period," an official with the Japan Ship Exporters' Association said.
Orders for November comprised four freighters, two bulk carriers, seven tankers and one refrigerated cargo carrier, the association said.
From April to October, Japan received ship export orders for 144 vessels, or 4.36 million grt, the association said.
